format.consolation_rules: After the final, every wrestler who lost to the champion is eligible for 2nd. They wrestle back in the order they lost (earliest loser first, 'WRB' bouts); the survivor meets the finalist loser in the 'Second' bout. For 3rd, the loser of the Second bout meets anyone who lost to the 2nd-place winner and has not already been eliminated; if nobody is eligible the Second-bout loser is awarded 3rd automatically (no bout).

result_legend.FALL: Fall (pin). Bracket shows 'Fall m:ss'; summary page sometimes writes 'WBF m:ss' for the same bout
result_legend.TA: Time-advantage decision (riding-time era; time shown is the winner's net advantage)
result_legend.BYE: Advanced on a bye (one side of the pairing empty)
result_legend.ot: true when the result text carries 'OT' (overtime period)

id_conventions.wrestler: <weight>-<nn> numbered top to bottom of the draw
id_conventions.championship_match: <weight>-<round>-<bout#> numbered top to bottom; the final is <weight>-F
id_conventions.from: {line:n} = draw line; {winner_of:id} / {loser_of:id} = participant came from that bout
id_conventions.winner_to/loser_to: where that wrestler appeared next (null = done). Filled from what actually happened, since Bergman wrestle-backs are only determined after the final
